non-blocking: it glosses the largest undecided family as the ion charge-state torque density due to collisions across fast and thermal, co- and counter-passing species, but 16 of its 51 members are electron species and 12 are trapped, so the description names roughly half the family the repair exists to describe accurately.

non-blocking: _derive_from_existing indexes ["largest"]["member_count"] unconditionally, so re-deriving an artifact that holds no undecided family raises TypeError after it has already rewritten the file.

non-blocking: the tests line records a direct-interpreter pytest command while sdpf-labelled-comparison-gate.log:3 records uv run --no-sync, so the gate receipt promotion fills from this line is not the literal command the log holds.
